description: Source code for the Gladia Speech-to-Text (STT) service implementation, providing real-time transcription via WebSocket API with support for multiple languages, custom vocabulary, and audio processing options.

classes.name: GladiaSTTService
classes.description: Implements a Speech-to-Text service using Gladia's WebSocket API, supporting real-time transcription, multiple languages, custom parameters, and connection management.

methods.name: language_to_gladia_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to Gladia's language code string.

methods.name: _InputParamsDescriptor
methods.description: Descriptor class for deprecated nested InputParams with deprecation warning.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GladiaSTTService with API key, region, model, parameters, buffer size, and other options.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that the service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a pipecat Language enum to Gladia's language code.

methods.name: _prepare_settings
methods.description: Prepares configuration settings for the Gladia session based on parameters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket connection for transcription.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket connection and ends transcription.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: run_stt
methods.description: Processes audio bytes for speech-to-text, handling buffering and WebSocket communication.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes session and WebSocket connection to Gladia.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket and cleans up tasks.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to Gladia.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _setup_gladia
methods.description: Initializes Gladia session via API call.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription results, stops metrics, and processes final transcripts.

methods.name: _on_speech_started
methods.description: Handles speech start event, broadcasts frame, and manages VAD interruption.

methods.name: _on_speech_ended
methods.description: Handles speech end event and broadcasts frame.

methods.name: _send_audio
methods.description: Sends audio chunk over WebSocket.

methods.name: _send_buffered_audio
methods.description: Sends buffered audio after reconnection.

methods.name: _send_stop_recording
methods.description: Sends stop recording command over WebSocket.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns current WebSocket connection or raises exception if not connected.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes messages from WebSocket.

methods.name: _keepalive_task_handler
methods.description: Periodically sends empty audio to keep WebSocket alive.
